content: The systems are evaluated in terms of micro-averaged precision, recall and F-1 score. Note that, in contrast to the evaluation in Experiment A, MEDDOCAN measurements are entity-based instead of tokenwise. An exhaustive explanation of the MEDDOCAN evaluation procedure is available online, as well as the official evaluation script, which we used to obtain the reported results.
